primary_population: main i3/8/15, exact complete Z, fit>=2 different H, matching eval. Repeat H kept with natural frequency
weighting: eval state natural frequency within C/i
H_shared: E2_gain CI97.5 lower>0 and each domain>=6 defined prompts
H_match: E3_gain CI97.5 lower>0 and each domain>=6 defined prompts containing nonzero pair step
bootstrap: whole original prompt rows per domain including undefined; no replacement for undefined draws; valid counts reported
fixed8: average8 permutations first; not8 independent experiments, no permutation p value
E3_damage_rate: per eval state, first mean8 paired TV differences then indicator<-1e-5; not per-permutation/arm damage
E3_real_raw_damage: mean8xstate indicators real-vs-raw<-1e-5; permutation arm analogous
positive_or_negative_small: continuous effects retained; 1e-5 only damage/qualitative sign
